decisions.reason: Strategic fit with data-driven infrastructure software and low marginal cost to keep as an option outweigh the absence of observed web promotion.
Weak strategic fit and no observed web presence indicate the option value is unlikely to be realized, so drop and reallocate resources.
Control technology remains core to the firm's connected machinery direction and is likely embedded in projects, so keep despite modest web visibility.
As a newer, strategically aligned software product, its option value remains high and keeping costs are low while its prospects resolve.
